question: Anita is standing facing the north direction. Then, she turns 135° anticlockwise. After that, she turns 90° clockwise. In which direction is she facing now?
solution:
**Given:**

Anita is standing facing the north direction.

Then, she turns 135° anticlockwise.

After that, she turns 90° clockwise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72977e76a37a28270d901173ff3413b28f5bf996c25dc6522e00dd46454b2e8.png] 

So, Anita is facing '**North west**' direction.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
